function: OTFS channel estimation: an LSTM and shallow NN refine an LS estimate from time-frequency pilots and preamble, also compensating high-power-amplifier nonlinearities, at 300 km/h (pp. 1, 5-7).
system: SFFT-based OTFS, 64 subcarriers, 14 symbols, 10 MHz at 5.9 GHz; scalar single-link model, antenna count not stated; no RIS (pp. 3-4, 8).
method: LSTM interpolating an LS estimate, then a shallow NN (15 hidden neurons); supervised training, 8,000 samples, Adam, 500 epochs, MSE loss to perfect CSI (pp. 7-8, 11).
data_channel: Simulated ITU-T Vehicular-A channel (9 paths) at 300 km/h; 10,000 realizations, 80% training and 20% testing; memoryless HPA polynomial model (pp. 3, 7-8, 11).
test_conditions: Trained and tested on the same Vehicular-A scenario at 300 km/h (random 80/20 split); QPSK at IBO 2 dB, 16-QAM at IBO 4 dB; SNR sweep (pp. 7-8).
baselines: Non-learned: threshold estimator TCE [6] and correlation estimator CCE [7], both with delay-Doppler pilots; perfect CSI as reference. Learned: none (pp. 4-5, 8).
metrics: BER (QPSK, 16-QAM), throughput, PAPR CCDF and complexity order; no channel-estimation error metric (pp. 8-11).
complexity: LS-LSTM-NN: O(Mon^2 + Mp^2 + Mon Mp + Md N); TCE: O(MN + Md^3 N^3); CCE: O(kappa D M N log N + Md^3 N^3) (Table III, p. 11).
q1_support: p. 8: "considering the ITU-T Vehicular-A [36] with speed v = 300 km/h"; training and testing samples come from realizations of this channel (p. 7). Vehicular-A is a standardized model outside the listed ones, see notes.
q2_support: p. 7: "randomly selecting 80% and 20%, respectively, from a pool of 10,000 distinct realizations of the vehicular channel" is a held-out part of the same data; Table II (p. 8) lists one speed, 300 km/h, and the paper does not state a test at another speed, IBO, modulation or frame size.
q3_support: p. 8: "We compare our proposal with the benchmark methods TCE [6] and CCE [7]", both non-learned delay-Doppler estimators; no earlier learned estimator is compared, the authors' LSTM receiver [18] is only cited.
q4_support: p. 11: "Table III summarizes the complexity order required for each method compared in this paper"; for LS-LSTM-NN Eq. (45) gives O(Mon^2 + Mp^2 + Mon Mp + Md N).
q5_support: p. 8: "the codes used for the simulated results can be downloaded at [34]"; p. 12 gives [34] as https://github.com/anafreis/OTFS_CE.
notes: Area 4 because the problem is OTFS channel estimation at 300 km/h, although the estimator works on time-frequency pilots (pp. 5-7) and not on delay-Doppler pilots; if the reviewer assigns area 2 instead, the single-link system rule would apply since no antenna count or RIS is stated (pp. 3-4). q1: ITU-T Vehicular-A, cited to 3GPP TS 36.104 [36] (p. 8), is another standardized model, marked as met for the reviewer to confirm. The paper reports no channel-estimation error metric, only BER, throughput, PAPR and complexity.
